text:
rachel: Quick proposal: introduce an ephemeral retention lease flow for long-running forensics + legal requests. Default retention stays 90d for app logs / 365d for security logs, but we add timeboxed leases up to 720d on approval.

mika: Can you sketch the approval path? Who signs off for >365d?

rachel: Proposal: 1) Owner opens a JIRA with tag `siem-lease` + justification and TTL. 2) Security reviews; for >365d Legal must countersign. 3) SRE executes a TTL change on the secured bucket and records the lease metadata in the audit ledger. 4) Lease auto-revokes at expiry and a cleanup ticket runs.

samir: Thoughts on implementation: we should avoid manual SRE steps long-term. Suggest an internal service endpoint `/internal/siem/leases` that accepts a signed approval token from security and applies lifecycle rules. For now ops + runbook.

pete_sre: Ops note: lifecycle rule changes take up to 24h to propagate; we need the runbook to account for that and for backfills. Backfill size estimate depends on query slice. I'll draft a checklist: snapshot -> copy -> validate -> rotate lifecycle.

mika: RBAC: do we create a new role `siem:lease-approver` or reuse `security:admin`? Prefer narrower roles.

rachel: New role `siem_lease_admin` with scoped scopes like `siem_lease_admin:team=<team>` + audit justification required. Raw unmasked export still gated by `siem_unmask` and JIT via KMS-proxy.

security-bot: Reminder: All KMS operations must include CMK identifier and an approver. See https://internal/redwood/security/kms-guidelines.

legal-eu: We need a template for the legal attestation for multi-region retention (EU data). We'll only permit >365d with explicit legal justification and data residency controls.

rachel: Good call. Add an extra field in the JIRA: `DataResidency: <region>` and `LegalApproval: <ticket>` for >365d.

samir: Partner access question: vendors currently use signed URLs. During lease we should avoid broad signed-URL grants. Instead provision temporary tokens scoped to specific prefixes and log each fetch.

pete_sre: We can implement short-lived signed URLs with a fetch log forwarder into the immutable audit stream. That gives traceability.

mika: What about KMS key strategy? Org CMK vs per-tenant?

rachel: Roadmap: Phase A = org CMK with envelope keys per-bucket. Phase B = per-tenant CMKs when provisioning automation exists. For now leases will be wrapped with org CMK but include per-lease envelope metadata.

security-bot: Note: Key rotation frequency policy requires rotation schedule documented in the lease metadata.

legal-eu: Also request that any extended lease include a disposal plan and custodian contact. 

rachel: Agreed. JIRA template fields: Owner, Reason, TTL, CMK, DataResidency, LegalApproval (if needed), Custodian, PartnersImpacted, CleanupTicket.

samir: Edge case: incident triage often needs raw stacks older than 90d for root cause. Can the lease be retroactive (i.e., backfill previous data)?

rachel: Yes — backfill allowed but must be included in the justification and cost estimate. We'll require a snapshot hash and validation step. Backfills will be rate-limited and cost-tracked.

pete_sre: Cost rough numbers: copying 1TB between buckets in same region ~ $10-$15 in S3 charges + PUTs; cross-region more. I'll add cost estimation to the runbook.

mika: Operational checks: monthly review board for active leases, automated alerts 14d/7d/1d before TTL expiry, and expiration audits.

security-bot: Action item recorded: create policy doc `siem/lease-lifecycle` and wire the policy to the auditboard.

rachel: I'll open the policy PR and kick off a pilot with Security + SRE + Legal. Pilot window: 2 weeks overlap when we migrate partner feeds.

samir: I'll prototype the `/internal/siem/leases` API (auth via service tokens). Will include a dry-run mode to validate lifecycle rule changes.

pete_sre: Ping me for pilot scheduling. I'll prepare the rollback plan: 1) disable new lifecycle rules, 2) snapshot copies, 3) re-enable previous access grants.

mika: :thumbsup: Also ensure partner communications include a cert rotation if we change signing key for signed URLs.

legal-eu: We'll draft an attestation checklist and pre-approved language for JIRA attachments.

rachel: Thanks. If no objections, I'll file `ENGSEC-1234` with the template and list of approvers. Please react with :eyes: if you want on the approver list.

mika: :eyes:

samir: :eyes: I'll drop a proto link soon.

pete_sre: :eyes: Scheduling follow-up for next Tue.

security-bot: Closing note: any extended leases that include third-party exports must include an explicit partner access log and a signed MOU.
